name: changelog-automation
description: Add and maintain a Changelog on any Figma file — a design system, a design file (screens/flows), or both. changelog-setup bootstraps the page + baseline and schedules a recurring sweep (default weekly Mondays 9am, day/time configurable); changelog-sweep fingerprints the file, detects drift from the baseline, and auto-logs changes. Includes the canonical scoped fingerprint algorithm, portable changelog conventions, and a scheduled-sweep template.
